items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and leave rights outreach unsent pending owner authorization and human counsel review. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, display, caching, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms restrict product-listing, price, and derivative use. Legal launch tasks remain open, and accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, security/release, and owner gates are blocked. Existing technical compliance is mixed at 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown; this is not certification. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, or unreviewed claims. Next evidence action: attach one dated consolidated evidence bundle covering the four open legal tasks without changing production or sending outreach.
